headline: Scaloni 'pushed hard' to convince Messi to return for farewell match
summary: Argentina's coach Lionel Scaloni revealed he urged the retired legend to make one final appearance against Benin on Oct 6 in Buenos Aires.
details: Lionel Scaloni admitted he "pushed hard" to persuade Lionel Messi to return for a final international appearance. The match against Benin is scheduled for Oct 6 at the Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires.

Messi had retired from international football in August after Argentina's 1-0 extra-time defeat to Spain in the 2026 World Cup final. He ended his career as the record appearance-maker and scorer for Argentina with 207 caps and 125 goals.
Scaloni explained that he wanted to ensure the farewell happened now because he was uncertain if he would still be the coach when another opportunity arose. His contract is set to expire in December.

The 39-year-old Messi expressed that the decision to retire "hurt in the soul," but felt it was the right time to step aside. He has won the Copa America in 2021 and 2024 and captained the team to the 2022 World Cup title.
The farewell match is the final of three home friendlies. Argentina will also face Bolivia in Cordoba on Sept 30 and Burkina Faso in Buenos Aires on Oct 3.
The Argentine Football Association (AFA) confirmed that Rodrigo De Paul and Giovani Lo Celso will join Messi for the final friendly match.
caption:

Scaloni explained that he wanted to ensure the farewell happened now because he was uncertain if he would still be the coach when another opportunity arose. His contract is set to expire in December.

The 39-year-old Messi expressed that the decision to retire "hurt in the soul," but felt it was the right time to step aside. He has won the Copa America in 2021 and 2024 and captained the team to the 2022 World Cup title.

The farewell match is the final of three home friendlies. Argentina will also face Bolivia in Cordoba on Sept 30 and Burkina Faso in Buenos Aires on Oct 3.

The Argentine Football Association (AFA) confirmed that Rodrigo De Paul and Giovani Lo Celso will join Messi for the final friendly match.

headline: Israel's Abu Farchi sent off for gun gesture during goal celebration
summary: The 20-year-old forward received a red card after using a corner flag to simulate a firing gun against Austria in the UEFA Nations League.
details: Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi was sent off during a UEFA Nations League match against Austria on Thursday.
The 20-year-old scored a header in the 55th minute to bring Israel level at 1-1 at the Raiffeisen Arena in Linz.
During his celebration, Abu Farchi grabbed the corner flag and used it to simulate a gun-firing gesture.
Having been booked four minutes earlier, the referee showed him a second yellow card followed by a red, leaving Israel with 10 players.
Austria eventually regained the lead in the 90th minute and added a third in stoppage time, winning the match 3-1.
caption:
A goal celebration turned into a red card. Israel's Saied Abu Farchi was sent off for simulating a gun with a corner flag.

Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi was sent off during a UEFA Nations League match against Austria on Thursday.

During his celebration, Abu Farchi grabbed the corner flag and used it to simulate a gun-firing gesture.

Having been booked four minutes earlier, the referee showed him a second yellow card followed by a red, leaving Israel with 10 players.

Austria eventually regained the lead in the 90th minute and added a third in stoppage time, winning the match 3-1.
